Nobody underwrites a services firm. You underwrite the bench.

Three weeks of diligence on a 120 person business in Latin America, mostly data and AI engineers. Signed last week.

The valuation model was never where the risk sat. Multiples for this profile fall inside a narrow band and everyone at the table knows the band. The whole number came down to whether the work reads as staff augmentation or as capability. Two very different prices for the same payroll.

Cost against a US team is roughly half, sometimes better, and it was the least interesting thing in the file. Cost advantages disappear when a competitor opens an office in the same city. What does not disappear is a group of people who already know how to work together.

The harder conversation was about what we were declining to pay for. A meaningful share of the hours on that P&L are hours an AI model now performs. Those hours have been repriced by the market already.

Which left the question of what a client still pays a person for. Judgment on what not to build. Sitting with a customer who cannot articulate the outcome. Someone senior enough to say the AI model is wrong, and be believed by juniors who have (sadly) stopped checking the AI output.

Everything else came down to four questions: 
Revenue concentration by person, not by logo. Whether renewals sit on outcomes or on hours. Whether the founder is the relationship or the firm is. What leaves the firm with the top five names.

Retention, well…acquired employees leave at roughly three times the rate of a normal hire inside twelve months, and rarely the ones you would let go. Twenty names were identified in week one and we made sure they had terms before signing. 

That was the deal.

I think the next round of transactions in this region gets bought for the quality of the bench and not the backlog. Volume across LatAm is down this year while value has held. Fewer processes, larger checks, mostly about capability.

Last, we got AI in the room as an advisor for three weeks. Faster than any of us at reading. Nothing useful to say about which twenty names mattered 😎

It as a busy week and a good close. More to come.
